evidence.expiry: 『pending patent applications, which, if issued, could expire at least as late as 2046』+『CRENESSITY has been granted seven years of orphan drug exclusivity by the FDA』+『we face the risk that our licensors could...lose patent protection...thereby impairing or extinguishing our rights under our licenses』→特許束・オーファン独占の期限型独占=yes
evidence.moatdecay: 『positions us to deliver multiple potential first-in-class or best-in-class treatments in psychiatry over the coming years』+ INGREZZA(TD/HD chorea)拡大・CRENESSITY(CAH)立上げ・パイプライン『ranging from late-stage to first-in-human』→堀は拡大中=no
evidence.erosion: 『Lower negotiated prices for AUSTEDO and AUSTEDO XR may increase competitive pressures on INGREZZA, including heightened pricing pressure and potential adverse effects on formulary coverage』+『INGREZZA qualifies for the small biotec[h exception]』(IRA)→競合AUSTEDO+IRA価格圧力が顕在化しつつある=emerging
evidence.disrupt: IRAが『negotiate the price of certain high-expenditure, single-source drugs and biologics covered under Medicare』で単剤を明示標的化。技術代替(蝕/循キーワード)のヒットは無いが特許崖・薬価交渉で長期の経済モデルが未確定=unsettled
evidence.dom: 『We launched INGREZZA (valbenazine) in the U.S. as the first FDA-approved drug for the treatment of TD』+『CRENESSITY...as a first-in-class FDA-approved treatment of CAH — the first new treatment for CAH in over 70 years』。ただしTDはAUSTEDO(VMAT2)が競合=独占90%未満、圧倒的リーダー→85
evidence.irr: 『obtain patent protection for our products』+オーファン薬指定+『first FDA-approved drug』=FDA承認・規格ロックによる高摩擦移行→85
evidence.rep: 『validated biological pathways』『biology developed over three decades』+first-in-class。数十年の知見だが小分子は特許満了後にジェネリック複製可(数十年/$10B級の永続複製不能とは言えない)→極困難80
evidence.dur: 『We also own, or have licensed rights to, patents covering our other products』+オーファン独占+30年のCRF/VMAT2プロセス知=規制/プロセス知型の堀→100(期間限界はexpiry=yesで別途表現)
evidence.geopol: 米国内単一市場のバイオ。地政学的テンションは軽微=0。集中リスクは製品(INGREZZA)・薬価政策(IRA single-source)であり地政学ではない旨を分離
evidence.concentration: 『INGREZZA...significant portion of our total net product sales during each of these years』vs『CRENESSITY net product sales were $301.2 million for 2025』→単剤集中度が本銘柄の主リスク(dom/expiry/f群で織込み)
evidence.p2: COVID時に営利は増加(72.3→163.0M)し耐性を示すが本格不況の実績なし→70上限
evidence.p4: accr=-6.6%(<0)+『Unresolved Staff Comments None』。material weaknessヒットは監査手続の定型文(『assessing the risk that a material weakness exists』)で実指摘ではない→90
evidence.f1: ROIIC(2023→25): ΔNOPAT≈232M/ΔIC≈360M=約64%。op250.9→619.1Mを僅少な追加資本で達成、WACC(バイオ~9-10%)+15を大きく超過→90
evidence.f2: TD推定80万人(米)に対しINGREZZA浸透は低〜中位、CRENESSITY(CAH新規)・HD chorea等の未浸透市場多数→一桁〜低位浸透で高い残余余地→80
evidence.f3: R&D投資は継続的に高水準(パイプライン『late-stage to first-in-human』)+INGREZZAシェアとCRENESSITY立上げで販売趨勢+の両符号→90
evidence.f4: CRENESSITY(CAH=TDと隣接領域)がFY2025 $301.2M=売上約10.5%(>5%)で発売初年成長中→80
